title: When Agents Fail: Model or Harness--Who's to Blame?
title_zh: 当智能体失败时：模型还是执行框架——该怪谁？

paragraphs.en: LLM agents combine models with execution harnesses, so agentic benchmark performance reflects their joint behavior. We argue that harnesses should therefore be evaluated through their interactions with underlying models. We develop a framework combining five complementary measures: (i) Valid Completion Rate (VCR), how reliably agents finish normally and deliver evaluable results, irrespective of task correctness; (ii) Model–Harness Fit, how well a harness supports task achievement through valid completion for a given model; (iii) Cross-Model Fit, a harness’s overall suitability across evaluated models; (iv) Interaction Residuals, pairing-specific execution strengths and weaknesses hidden by component-level summaries; and (v) Token Load, the token demands of agent execution, including failed attempts. We evaluate four general-purpose harnesses ( OpenCode , Codex CLI , Pi CLI , and DeepAgents ) with four core models, plus two fixed native model–harness systems, on six benchmarks covering context management, tool use, long-context planning, multimodal interaction, and artifact handoff. Including native references and stress conditions, 111 evaluation settings yield 52,168 trajectories . Harness rankings vary across models and benchmarks; task performance and valid completion can favor different pairings, and similar task scores can accompany distinct execution profiles. OpenCode ranks first in cross-model performance, while DeepSeek V4 Flash Preview maintains consistently high Mean VCR across harnesses on the shared four-benchmark panel . These findings support evaluating model–harness interactions, training transferable harness-use capabilities in models, and harness designs adapted to the model and task.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 智能体将模型与执行框架结合在一起，因此智能体基准测试的性能反映的是二者的联合行为。 我们主张，应当通过执行框架与底层模型的交互来评估执行框架。 我们提出了一个包含五项互补指标的框架：(i) 有效完成率（VCR），即智能体无论任务对错、能正常结束并给出可评估结果的可靠程度；(ii) 模型—框架适配度，即执行框架在给定模型上通过有效完成来支持任务达成的程度；(iii) 跨模型适配度，即执行框架在被评估的各模型上的整体适用性；(iv) 交互残差，即被组件级汇总所掩盖的特定配对在执行上的强项与弱项；(v) 令牌负载，即智能体执行（包括失败的尝试）所需的令牌量。 我们在涵盖上下文管理、工具使用、长上下文规划、多模态交互和产出物交接的六个基准上，用四个核心模型评估了四个通用执行框架（OpenCode、Codex CLI、Pi CLI 和 DeepAgents），并加入了两个固定的原生模型—框架系统。 包括原生参照和压力条件在内，111 个评估设置共产生 52,168 条轨迹。 执行框架的排名因模型和基准而异；任务性能和有效完成可能偏好不同的配对，相似的任务得分也可能伴随不同的执行特征。 OpenCode 在跨模型性能上排名第一，而 DeepSeek V4 Flash Preview 在共享的四基准面板上于各执行框架下均保持较高的平均 VCR。 这些发现支持评估模型—框架交互、在模型中训练可迁移的框架使用能力，以及设计适配模型与任务的执行框架。

paragraphs.en: Classical views describe intelligent agents as goal-oriented systems that continuously perceive their environment, maintain internal state, select actions, and improve behavior through feedback ( Wooldridge and Jennings, 1995 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) . An LLM agent implements this paradigm by integrating a large language model (LLM) into an executable system for perception, reasoning, and action in external environments ( Yao et al., 2023 ) . At the system level, an LLM agent combines its model with an execution layer, the agent harness , that connects the model to the environment ( Guo et al., 2026 ; Kwa et al., 2025 ; Yao et al., 2026 ) . The harness provides mechanisms for observation processing, context management, tool and action interfaces, workflow control, state management, execution, evaluation, and error handling. By controlling how information is presented to the model and how its outputs are executed, the harness shapes agent behavior and task performance ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) .
paragraphs.zh: 经典观点将智能体描述为以目标为导向的系统，它们持续感知环境、维护内部状态、选择动作，并通过反馈改进行为（Wooldridge and Jennings, 1995；Wang et al., 2024）。 LLM 智能体通过将大语言模型（LLM）集成到一个可执行的系统中，在外部环境中实现感知、推理和行动，从而落实这一范式（Yao et al., 2023）。 在系统层面，LLM 智能体将其模型与一个执行层（即智能体框架 agent harness）相结合，该框架将模型与环境连接起来（Guo et al., 2026；Kwa et al., 2025；Yao et al., 2026）。 该框架提供了观察处理、上下文管理、工具与动作接口、工作流控制、状态管理、执行、评估以及错误处理等机制。 通过控制信息呈现给模型的方式以及模型输出被执行的方式，该框架塑造了智能体的行为和任务表现（Zhang et al., 2025b）。

paragraphs.en: Under this system view, end-to-end benchmark performance reflects the joint behavior of the model–harness system rather than model capability alone ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Yao et al., 2026 ) . Yet most benchmarks remain task-centric, evaluating fixed model–harness configurations by task success or aggregate reward while treating the harness as part of the setup. These evaluations summarize system-level success; execution diagnostics and crossed comparisons provide complementary views of performance sources. Failures may reflect insufficient model capability, ineffective harness use, or harness limitations in observation processing, action interfaces, state management, or recovery ( Ma et al., 2024 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ; Yao et al., 2026 ) . An empirical issue study reports failures occurring only when particular model behaviors interact with harness parsing, control flow, or context handling ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . Conversely, high performance may partly reflect the harness’s task-specific workflows or additional computation ( Lou et al., 2026 ; Lee et al., 2026 ) . Controlled studies show that changing harnesses can alter performance and rankings with models and tasks fixed ( Zhu et al., 2026 ; Yao et al., 2026 ) . Understanding agent failure therefore requires examining the model, the harness, and their particular pairing through crossed comparisons and execution evidence. This assessment distinguishes failure to solve the task from abnormal termination or invalid evaluator handoff: a run may complete validly without solving the task, or earn task credit despite abnormal termination.
paragraphs.zh: 在这一系统视角下，端到端基准测试成绩反映的是「模型–测试框架」系统的联合行为，而不仅仅是模型能力（Yang et al., 2024；Yao et al., 2026）。 然而，大多数基准测试仍以任务为中心，通过任务成功与否或聚合奖励来评估固定的「模型–测试框架」配置，并将测试框架视为实验设置的一部分。 这些评估总结的是系统层面的成功；执行诊断与交叉比较则为性能来源提供了互补的视角。 失败可能反映模型能力不足、测试框架使用不当，或测试框架在观测处理、动作接口、状态管理或恢复方面的局限（Ma et al., 2024；Zhu et al., 2026；Yao et al., 2026）。 一项实证问题研究报告了仅在特定模型行为与测试框架的解析、控制流或上下文处理相互作用时才出现的失败（Chen et al., 2026）。 反过来，高成绩也可能部分源于测试框架针对特定任务的工作流或额外的计算（Lou et al., 2026；Lee et al., 2026）。 受控研究表明，在模型和任务固定的情况下，更换测试框架会改变成绩和排名（Zhu et al., 2026；Yao et al., 2026）。 因此，理解智能体失败需要通过交叉比较和执行证据，考察模型、测试框架以及二者特定的配对方式。 本评估将未能解决任务与异常终止或无效的评估器交接区分开来：一次运行可能在不解决任务的情况下有效完成，也可能在异常终止的情况下仍获得任务得分。

paragraphs.en: The missing object of evaluation lies at the model–harness boundary. A model’s harness-use capability depends on how effectively it can interact with a given harness: the same interface, action space, or feedback mechanism may be easy for one model to use but challenging for another, while the same model may behave differently under different harness designs ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Yao et al., 2026 ) . Accordingly, harness difficulty should be understood as a model-dependent interaction cost introduced by the harness’s observation format, action interface, state management, control flow, and recovery mechanisms. When this cost exceeds the model’s harness-use capability, the harness may prevent the model from realizing its underlying capabilities; when the harness provides extensive task-specific support, it may improve performance by contributing part of the task-solving process. Existing task-level evaluations conflate these effects into a single outcome, making it difficult to distinguish model capability from harness effects ( Messick, 1995 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ; Yao et al., 2026 ) . Therefore, evaluating agents requires examining both task achievement and valid completion, together with how these outcomes vary across model–harness pairings.
paragraphs.zh: 评估的缺失对象位于模型与运行框架的边界处。 模型的运行框架使用能力取决于它与给定运行框架交互的有效程度：相同的接口、动作空间或反馈机制对一个模型来说可能容易使用，对另一个模型却可能具有挑战性，而同一模型在不同的运行框架设计下也可能表现不同（Yang et al., 2024；Yao et al., 2026）。 因此，运行框架难度应被理解为运行框架的观察格式、动作接口、状态管理、控制流和恢复机制所引入的依赖于模型的交互成本。 当这一成本超过模型的运行框架使用能力时，运行框架可能阻碍模型发挥其底层能力；当运行框架提供大量针对任务的支持时，它可能通过承担部分任务解决过程来提升性能。 现有的任务级评估将这些效应混为一个单一结果，使得难以区分模型能力与运行框架效应（Messick, 1995；Zhu et al., 2026；Yao et al., 2026）。 因此，评估智能体需要同时考察任务达成与有效完成，以及这些结果在不同模型与运行框架组合下的变化情况。

paragraphs.en: We develop metrics to analyze model–harness interaction through task performance and operational validity . Valid Completion Rate (VCR) measures how often attempts terminate normally with valid evaluator handoff, regardless of task correctness. Model–harness Fit and Cross-Model Fit summarize task performance from valid completions for individual models and across models. We analyze their diagnostic value and robustness, failure patterns, and resource use. We implement a common agent adapter for this study, preserving native execution loops under matched tasks and controlled execution conditions. We cross four general-purpose harnesses—DeepAgents, OpenCode, Pi CLI, and Codex CLI—with multiple models on six benchmarks: SWE-bench-45 ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Chowdhury et al., 2024 ) , Terminal-Bench 2 ( Merrill et al., 2026 ) , VitaBench ( He et al., 2026 ) , LOCA-Bench ( Zeng et al., 2026 ) , ClawMark ( Meng et al., 2026 ) , and AgentSkillOS ( Li et al., 2026 ) . Fixed native systems add complete-system references. Figure 1 summarizes the evaluation framework.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开发了一系列指标，通过任务表现与操作有效性来分析模型与执行框架（harness）之间的交互。 有效完成率（VCR）衡量的是尝试以有效交接给评估器的正常方式终止的频率，而不考虑任务是否正确。 模型-执行框架契合度与跨模型契合度基于有效完成情况，分别总结单个模型与跨模型的任务表现。 我们分析了这些指标的诊断价值与稳健性、失败模式以及资源使用情况。 在本研究中，我们实现了一个通用的智能体适配器，在匹配的任务和受控的执行条件下保留原生的执行循环。 我们将四个通用执行框架——DeepAgents、OpenCode、Pi CLI 和 Codex CLI——与多个模型在六个基准上进行交叉测试：SWE-bench-45（Jimenez et al., 2024；Chowdhury et al., 2024）、Terminal-Bench 2（Merrill et al., 2026）、VitaBench（He et al., 2026）、LOCA-Bench（Zeng et al., 2026）、ClawMark（Meng et al., 2026）以及 AgentSkillOS（Li et al., 2026）。 固定的原生系统则作为完整系统参考。 图 1 概括了该评估框架。

sents.zh: 我们开发了一系列指标，通过任务表现与操作有效性来分析模型与执行框架（harness）之间的交互。

sents.en: Valid Completion Rate (VCR) measures how often attempts terminate normally with valid evaluator handoff, regardless of task correctness.
sents.zh: 有效完成率（VCR）衡量的是尝试以有效交接给评估器的正常方式终止的频率，而不考虑任务是否正确。

sents.en: Model–harness Fit and Cross-Model Fit summarize task performance from valid completions for individual models and across models.
sents.zh: 模型-执行框架契合度与跨模型契合度基于有效完成情况，分别总结单个模型与跨模型的任务表现。

sents.en: We analyze their diagnostic value and robustness, failure patterns, and resource use.
sents.zh: 我们分析了这些指标的诊断价值与稳健性、失败模式以及资源使用情况。

sents.en: We implement a common agent adapter for this study, preserving native execution loops under matched tasks and controlled execution conditions.
sents.zh: 在本研究中，我们实现了一个通用的智能体适配器，在匹配的任务和受控的执行条件下保留原生的执行循环。

sents.en: We cross four general-purpose harnesses—DeepAgents, OpenCode, Pi CLI, and Codex CLI—with multiple models on six benchmarks: SWE-bench-45 ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Chowdhury et al., 2024 ) , Terminal-Bench 2 ( Merrill et al., 2026 ) , VitaBench ( He et al., 2026 ) , LOCA-Bench ( Zeng et al., 2026 ) , ClawMark ( Meng et al., 2026 ) , and AgentSkillOS ( Li et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 我们将四个通用执行框架——DeepAgents、OpenCode、Pi CLI 和 Codex CLI——与多个模型在六个基准上进行交叉测试：SWE-bench-45（Jimenez et al., 2024；Chowdhury et al., 2024）、Terminal-Bench 2（Merrill et al., 2026）、VitaBench（He et al., 2026）、LOCA-Bench（Zeng et al., 2026）、ClawMark（Meng et al., 2026）以及 AgentSkillOS（Li et al., 2026）。

sents.en: Fixed native systems add complete-system references.
sents.zh: 固定的原生系统则作为完整系统参考。

sents.zh: 图 1 概括了该评估框架。

paragraphs.en: Harness rankings vary across models and benchmarks in both task performance and operational validity, which can favor different harnesses for one model. Their joint distribution distinguishes execution profiles among configurations with similar success rates: clean runs may leave tasks unsolved, while non-clean runs may succeed or earn continuous-score credit. Pair-specific VCR deviations beyond model and harness averages also change sign across benchmarks. Resource use varies across models and tasks: the lightest harness changes across configurations, and lower token use can accompany lower outcomes. Low use can reflect premature termination; high use can include repeated failed actions. Cross-Model Fit identifies a stable aggregate leader on the evaluated panel, but model-specific preferences and intermediate ranks depend on its models and benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: 不同模型和基准下的测试框架排名在任务表现和运行有效性上均有差异，这可能使同一模型偏向不同的测试框架。 它们的联合分布能够区分成功率相近的配置的执行特征：干净的运行可能仍未解决任务，而非干净的运行则可能成功或获得连续分数加分。 超出模型与测试框架平均水平的成对特定 VCR 偏差在不同基准上也会改变符号。 资源使用在不同模型和任务间存在差异：最轻量测试框架在不同配置间会变化，且较低的 token 使用可能伴随较低的成果。 低使用量可能反映过早终止；高使用量可能包含反复失败的操作。 跨模型拟合在被评估的面板上确定了一个稳定的总体领先者，但针对特定模型的偏好和中间排名取决于其涉及的模型和基准。

paragraphs.en: These findings motivate joint assessment of task performance and operational validity: their joint distribution identifies task progress achieved through valid completion, while resource use describes its cost. Harness use should be trained and evaluated as a transferable capability across interfaces, including action construction, feedback use, recovery, and stopping. Harness design should adapt observation, recovery, and resource-control policies to the model and task.

paragraphs.en: LLM agents couple a model to an execution layer that constructs observations, exposes actions, maintains state, and closes the feedback loop. ReAct made this loop explicit, while SWE-agent and OpenHands showed how interfaces and runtime infrastructure shape agent behavior ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) . A parallel line treats the surrounding system as an optimization target: GPTSwarm optimizes agent graphs, and ADAS and AFlow search over code-defined agent systems and workflows ( Zhuge et al., 2024 ; Hu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) . More recent methods optimize constraints, context, full harness implementations, or editable agent code from execution feedback ( Lou et al., 2026 ; Lee et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026b ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Lin et al., 2026 ) . These methods show that the surrounding program can substantially change fixed-model performance. These methods focus on agent-system optimization. Evaluating interaction difficulty, task-solving structure, and pairing-specific compatibility is a complementary objective.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 智能体将模型与一个执行层耦合在一起，该执行层负责构建观测、暴露动作、维护状态并闭合反馈回路。 ReAct 使这一回路变得显式，而 SWE-agent 和 OpenHands 展示了接口与运行时基础设施如何塑造智能体行为（Yao et al., 2023；Yang et al., 2024；Wang et al., 2025）。 另一条平行的研究路线将周围的系统视为优化目标：GPTSwarm 优化智能体图，ADAS 和 AFlow 则在由代码定义的智能体系统与工作流上进行搜索（Zhuge et al., 2024；Hu et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2025a）。 更新的方法则从执行反馈出发，优化约束、上下文、完整的测试套件实现或可编辑的智能体代码（Lou et al., 2026；Lee et al., 2026；Xu et al., 2026b；Zhang et al., 2026a；Zhang et al., 2026b；Lin et al., 2026）。 这些方法表明，周围的程序能够显著改变固定模型的性能。 这些方法聚焦于智能体系统的优化。 评估交互难度、任务求解结构以及配对双方的特定兼容性，则是一个互补的目标。

paragraphs.en: Most agent benchmarks report task outcomes for a complete system ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Mialon et al., 2024 ; Yao et al., 2025 ; Fu et al., 2026 ) ; AgentBoard adds progress and trajectory diagnostics but remains task-centered ( Ma et al., 2024 ) . Recent work addresses execution-layer confounding by crossing native harnesses and models or using shared adapters with standardized traces ( Yao et al., 2026 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) . Harness-Bench and harness-evolution analyses further show that harness effects are model-dependent ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) . Other studies recommend reporting harness–model pairs, resource use, and failure profiles, and matching feedback budgets and held-out tasks ( Vats and Golev, 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) . Trace-level scaling work further distinguishes useful feedback from raw resource expenditure ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) . These studies complement final-success measurements with rankings and diagnostics of complete configurations. Our work measures task performance and operational validity across model–harness pairings, evaluates their joint contribution to effective operation, and quantifies pairing-specific deviations from additive component averages.
paragraphs.zh: 大多数智能体基准报告的是完整系统的任务结果（Liu et al., 2024; Mialon et al., 2024; Yao et al., 2025; Fu et al., 2026）；AgentBoard 增加了进度和轨迹诊断，但仍以任务为中心（Ma et al., 2024）。 近期工作通过交叉组合原生 harness 与模型，或使用带有标准化轨迹的共享适配器，来解决执行层的混淆问题（Yao et al., 2026; Zheng et al., 2026; Wang et al., 2026a）。 Harness-Bench 和 harness 演化分析进一步表明，harness 的影响依赖于具体模型（Zhang et al., 2026a）。 其他研究建议报告 harness–模型配对、资源使用和失败特征，并对齐反馈预算与保留任务（Vats and Golev, 2026; Wang et al., 2026b）。 轨迹层面的扩展工作进一步区分了有用的反馈与原始的资源消耗（Zhang et al., 2026c）。 这些研究通过排名和完整配置的诊断，补充了对最终成功率的度量。 我们的工作跨模型–harness 配对度量任务性能和运行有效性，评估二者对有效运行的联合贡献，并量化特定配对相对于组件可加平均值的偏差。

paragraphs.en: Interpreting agent scores requires specifying the model, harness, and task conditions that produced them ( Messick, 1995 ) . We first describe how a model and harness form an executable agent, then distinguish task performance from operational validity and explain how their joint assessment characterizes effective operation. We also establish conditions for comparing model–harness pairings.
paragraphs.zh: 解读智能体得分需要说明产生这些得分所依据的模型、测试框架（harness）与任务条件（Messick, 1995）。 我们首先描述模型与测试框架如何构成一个可执行的智能体，然后区分任务表现与运行有效性，并解释如何通过二者的联合评估来刻画有效运行。 我们还建立了比较模型–测试框架组合的条件。

paragraphs.en: Building on this execution loop, we distinguish two dimensions of model–harness operation: task performance , how well the final state satisfies the task’s success criterion, and operational validity , whether execution terminates normally with an evaluator-consumable state, regardless of correctness. The same interface can impose different demands across models and tasks ( Cronbach et al., 1972 ) . Task success and intermediate-action correctness describe the task-solving process, and task credit may survive abnormal termination. We therefore assess the two dimensions separately for diagnosis and jointly to characterize effective operation : task performance achieved through valid completion of the same attempt.
paragraphs.zh: 在此执行循环的基础上，我们区分出模型–框架运作的两个维度：任务表现，即最终状态在多大程度上满足任务的成功标准；以及运作有效性，即执行是否正常终止并产生可供评估器使用的状态，而无论其正确与否。 同一接口在不同模型和任务上可能提出不同的要求 ( Cronbach et al., 1972 ) 。 任务成功与中间动作正确性描述的是解决问题的过程，且任务得分可能在异常终止后仍然保留。 因此，我们分别评估这两个维度以进行诊断，并联合评估它们以刻画有效运作：即通过同一次尝试的有效完成所达到的任务表现。

paragraphs.en: Token Load is mean token consumption over all scheduled attempts, including failures. Tokens per Clean Run and Tokens per Success divide total consumption by the respective counts. paragraphs.en: We use 2,000 paired task-cluster bootstrap replicates, stratified by benchmark and by environment within VitaBench. Sampled tasks retain all repetitions and model–harness observations. Each replicate recomputes outcome, operational validity, interaction, Fit, and matched resource statistics, including each Fit block’s best-harness reference and Token Loads from provider-token records. We report pointwise percentile 95% intervals without multiplicity adjustment; cell-level resource summaries remain descriptive. Intervals summarize task-level sampling variation within the evaluated benchmark suite. Leave-one-benchmark-out analyses assess dependence on benchmark composition.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 2,000 组配对任务簇 bootstrap 重抽样，在 VitaBench 内按基准和按环境进行分层。 抽样到的任务保留所有重复次数与模型—测试框架观测。 每次重抽样重新计算结果、操作性效度、交互、Fit 以及匹配资源统计量，包括每个 Fit 区块的最佳测试框架参考值和来自提供商 token 记录的 Token Loads。 我们报告逐点的 95% 百分位区间，不做多重性调整；单元格层面的资源汇总仍为描述性内容。 这些区间概括了所评估基准套件内任务层面的抽样变异。 留一基准分析评估了对基准构成的依赖性。

paragraphs.en: To understand agent failures, we examine task achievement, valid completion, and resource use across model–harness pairings. We address three research questions:

paragraphs.en: Harness changes can reverse model rankings within a benchmark (RQ1). paragraphs.en: Recovery policies differ: Codex retries malformed-action JSON, Pi restarts only after continuation-role errors, OpenCode has no external fallback, and DeepAgents runs a finalization pass. All but one Codex event and every Pi event have no linked later response; the remaining Codex retry is unresolved. High VCR can thus coexist with action-realization gaps. Trajectory-level diagnostics therefore complement VCR.
paragraphs.zh: 恢复策略各不相同：Codex 会重试格式错误的动作 JSON，Pi 仅在续接角色错误后重启，OpenCode 没有外部回退机制，DeepAgents 则会运行一个最终化处理步骤。 除一个 Codex 事件外，所有 Codex 事件和全部 Pi 事件都没有关联的后续响应；剩下那个 Codex 重试仍未解决。 因此，高 VCR 可能与动作执行缺口并存。 因此，轨迹层面的诊断可以作为 VCR 的补充。

paragraphs.en: The outcome-only variant removes the valid-completion gate; the arithmetic variant replaces the cross-model geometric mean ( Table 5 ). Joint and official scores coincide in 37 of 72 benchmark-level cells; counting credit only from valid completions reduces scores in the other 35. paragraphs.en: We presented a framework for evaluating model–harness interaction through task performance, valid completion, and resource use. Across six benchmarks, harness rankings depend on the model and task, and similar task scores can accompany different execution profiles. These findings show that interpreting agent failures requires examining both components and their particular pairing. Task failure must be distinguished from execution or handoff failure: valid completion can leave a task unsolved, while abnormal termination can coexist with task credit. Model–harness Fit and Cross-Model Fit summarize task performance achieved through valid completion, while VCR and trajectory diagnostics provide information on execution failures beyond task scores. These findings support evaluating model–harness pairs and designing harnesses for reliable, efficient operation across models. They also motivate treating harness-use capability as a training objective, with the goal of sustaining strong task performance and valid completion across diverse execution interfaces, including harnesses unseen during training.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一个通过任务表现、有效完成和资源使用来评估模型–执行框架交互的框架。 在六个基准测试中，执行框架的排名取决于模型和任务，且相似的任务分数可能伴随不同的执行特征。 这些发现表明，解读智能体的失败需要同时考察两个组件及其特定组合。 必须将任务失败与执行或交接失败区分开来：有效完成可能意味着任务未被解决，而异常终止也可能与任务得分并存。 模型–执行框架契合度与跨模型契合度总结了通过有效完成所取得的任务表现，而 VCR 和轨迹诊断则提供了任务分数之外的执行失败信息。 这些发现支持对模型–执行框架组合进行评估，并支持设计能在不同模型上可靠、高效运行的执行框架。 这些发现还促使我们将执行框架使用能力作为训练目标，其目标是在多样的执行接口（包括训练中未见过的执行框架）上保持强大的任务表现和有效完成能力。

paragraphs.en: SWE-bench Verified assigns each task a human-annotated difficulty label based on the time an experienced developer is expected to need to identify and implement a solution. paragraphs.en: For SWE-bench-45, the normal-termination condition is a recognized normal stop ( Submitted , NoPatch , or a successful exit-zero completion), and the valid-handoff condition requires the evaluator to accept the patch at its application stage. For Terminal-Bench 2, normal termination requires a clean return without a timeout or unhandled framework failure, and valid handoff requires the post-run verifier to produce a consumable result. For LOCA-Bench, normal termination requires status=success ; valid handoff requires a finite final-state evaluator result, including one produced before a subsequently abnormal backend exit. For ClawMark, normal termination requires status=ok , return code zero, and no recorded framework failure; valid handoff requires a finite official score. For AgentSkillOS, normal termination requires the task runner to record status=completed ; valid handoff requires a newly copied generated file whose path matches, or is nested under, at least one task-declared expected output path. Task correctness is not required. For VitaBench, normal termination requires termination_reason=agent_stop , and valid handoff requires a finite evaluator reward. In every benchmark, correctness affects the official task outcome but is never part of the valid-handoff condition.

paragraphs.en: Trajectory status makes the system-level interpretation more concrete. We show a runtime-error comparison on Kimi in Table 23 . Codex has 114 fewer runtime errors than runner-up OpenCode across the same 300 attempts, and no timeout-like failures. Some non-Codex runs record an evaluator-correct environment state alongside an error status, separating final-state correctness from process termination and result write-back. paragraphs.en: The harnesses also differ in how they sustain long-horizon execution. OpenCode generally reaches high scores through relatively compact trajectories, translating model decisions into executable actions and state updates with fewer execution steps. DeepAgents generally produces longer trajectories with substantially more recorded execution steps. This extended execution increases exposure to turn-level timeouts and external service or transport failures. Some interrupted trajectories still receive substantial rubric credit, indicating that meaningful progress was made before termination. Pi and Codex remain effective for Qwen and M3, with performance depending more strongly on the model’s consistency in following the expected structured-action protocol.
paragraphs.zh: 这些测试框架在维持长程执行的方式上也有所不同。 OpenCode 通常通过相对紧凑的轨迹获得高分，以更少的执行步骤将模型决策转化为可执行的动作和状态更新。 DeepAgents 通常产生更长的轨迹，记录的执行步骤也明显更多。 这种延长的执行增加了遭受回合级超时以及外部服务或传输故障影响的风险。 一些被中断的轨迹仍然获得了可观的标准评分，这表明在终止之前已经取得了有意义的进展。 Pi 和 Codex 对 Qwen 和 M3 仍然有效，其性能更多取决于模型遵循预期结构化动作协议的一致性。
